sections.section: Why this issue exists. Include: - Problem background — what triggered this (bug report, user request, architectural gap) - Current state — what works now, what doesn't, relevant infrastructure/config - Dependencies — what must exist first (images, services, DNS, other issues) - Access/environment — how to reproduce, where to verify (cluster, URL, CI)
Exact file paths with change description
Links to blocking/blocked/related issues: - depends on #NNN — must be done first - blocks #NNN — this unblocks other work - related to #NNN — shares context - Write "None" if truly standalone
Concrete commands to verify the work is done. Examples: - curl https://app.example.com → 200 - kubectl get pods -n app → Running - npm test -- --filter=feature → pass
Checklist of quality gates that MUST pass before closing: - [ ] Tests pass (unit, integration) - [ ] Deployed to staging/verified - [ ] PR approved and merged

validation.rule: context must describe WHY this issue exists and current state
verification must have at least 1 concrete command or check
definition-of-done must have at least 1 checkbox (- [ ])
related-issues must list issues or explicitly state "None"
